Atlanta Dream Even WNBA Finals Against Golden State Valkyries

The Atlanta Dream evened the WNBA Finals series against the Golden State Valkyries by winning Game 2. Angel Reese was a dominant player for the Dream in the victory. The Valkyries attributed their loss to poor ball security. The Dream's mothers are present at the WNBA Finals as a support system.
